REAL_EDGE_GATEWAY.implemented_in: outside the capstone lineage (after hardware exists)

wearable_vs_fl_client.fl_client: edge compute entity (EdgeNode hosting the FL client)
wearable_vs_fl_client.today: Virtual Wearable -> Virtual Edge Node -> FL Client
wearable_vs_fl_client.future: Physical Wearable -> phone / laptop / edge gateway -> FL Client
wearable_vs_fl_client.statement: An ESP32-class sensor is never architected to execute the PyTorch training stack.

data_flows.live_inference_flow: DeviceSource -> ObservedRecord -> existing WearableStreamRuntime -> inference client -> POST /v1/infer-window (MODEL_V2_FINAL) -> product monitoring events
data_flows.local_training_flow: ObservedRecord (tee) + SIMULATION_LABEL_ADAPTER_V1 labels -> LOCAL_TRAINING_BUFFER -> federated local trainer -> UpdateSubmission
data_flows.buffer_write_direction: one-way from the observed stream into the buffer; the live path never reads the buffer

simulated_cohort_mapping.evidence: V2-FL-005 (SIM_FL_SITE_00..07 / SIM_P000101..108, 480 s sessions at 360 Hz)
simulated_cohort_mapping.additive_capstone_adapter_needed_for: new local batches only (new seeds via the same generator; CAP-006). The frozen cohort and its manifest are never modified; no second incompatible eight-client universe is created.
